records.context: one row per cell with any read: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (exact or corrected), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (distinct callable barcodes), ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` and ``level`` of the top barcode (empty unless ``perfect`` or ``great``), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (of matched reads), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` and ``quality``. Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.

With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.
records.translation: una fila por célula con alguna lectura: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (exactas o corregidas), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (códigos de barras distintos que se pueden llamar), ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` y ``level`` del código de barras principal (vacíos salvo que sea ``perfect`` o ``great``), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (de las lecturas emparejadas), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` y ``quality``. Con ``minority_min_reads`` de 2 o más, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` y la clase cuentan solo las lecturas que la regla conserva, y se añaden dos columnas: ``minority_ignored`` (lecturas dejadas fuera) y ``minority_rescued`` (True cuando la célula se llama solo gracias a la regla). Con ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`), el código de barras principal es el que tiene más peso, y se añaden cinco columnas. ``weight_top`` y ``weight_total`` son los pesos de lecturas sumados del código de barras principal y de la célula. ``d_weight_top`` es el término de distancia sumado de las lecturas del código de barras principal, y ``g_median_top`` su distancia mediana al núcleo (NaN si no hay ninguna). ``bleed_discounted`` cuenta los códigos de barras cuyo peso redujo el descuento por célula vecina.
